title: Recovery 6 - reassembly: the cooker's cable back into J8
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: All probes off. Lift J8's actuator, slide the cooker's own cable fully in and square, contacts facing the way they did before (see the 2026-11-04 bench photo), press the actuator down. Speaker back on J9.

callouts.label: Actuator: lift to open, press down to lock
callouts.note: The white flip actuator on the right of the 30-way FFC connector, with its end tabs. Lift it before the cable goes in, press it flat again once the cable sits square.

callouts.label: Pin-1 end (circle)
callouts.note: The printed circle at the lower end of the contact tails; '30' is printed at the other end. Pins 1-6 are the VIN group (J-077).

callouts.label: Cable enters here (actuator side)
callouts.note: From raptox's photos with a cable in J8 (2026-11-01 photo 04, the cooker's own FFC; 2026-11-04 photo 01, the 100 mm FFC): the cable comes in on the actuator side, opposite the contact tails, and runs off to the right. In photo 04 the cooker's FFC shows its blue stiffener on top.

callouts.label: Probes off (both holes)
callouts.note: Both holes (pin 1 square at the bottom, pin 2 round above). Nothing may stay on JP5 once the cable is in: it is the same copper as J8 pins 1-6 (J-077, J-080).
